name: smali
description: Smali (Dalvik bytecode assembly): highlighting, diagnostics, completion, navigation and quick fixes via smali-lsp.

smali.serverPath.description: Path to the smali-lsp binary. Empty: use smali-lsp from PATH.

smali.androidJar.description: Path to android.jar. Empty: newest platform in the Android SDK.

smali.apiLevel.description: API level used to pick android.jar from the SDK when androidJar is unset.

smali.extraRoots.description: Directories of reference smali (e.g. decompiled framework).

smali.cacheDir.description: Index cache directory. Empty: OS cache dir + smali-lsp.

smali.diagnostics.description: Severity override per diagnostic code, e.g. { "S301": "off" }.
